captions.facebook:
FINANCIAL EDUCATION · ARE YOU FINANCIALLY READY FOR TOMORROW? (education edition)

Thinking beyond property

For many families, the home is the largest financial decision they make, and sometimes the only plan.

Property is one part of a household's finances, alongside income, savings, debt, insurance and retirement.

Each has different risks, costs and time horizons. Understanding all of them gives a fuller picture.

This is education about the concepts, not a view on whether to buy, sell or invest in anything.

Are you financially ready for tomorrow?

Learn. Understand. Stay Informed.

#TwoMarketLedger #AreYouFinanciallyReady #FinancialLiteracy

For information and education only. Not financial advice.
